prompt: A fraud team has 120 labelled frauds and two million clean transactions. Which step helps most?

choices.why: That throws away evidence and adds no fraud.

prompt: What is the one honest argument for undersampling?

choices.text: It invents leavers that the data never contained
choices.why: That is SMOTE, and undersampling invents nothing.

choices.text: It needs no correction afterwards
choices.why: Its chances are inflated and need the formula.

choices.text: It makes training cheap on data too large to fit
choices.why: Yes. Fewer rows, as long as the chances are corrected.

choices.text: It raises AUC
choices.why: It lowered average precision most of all.

choices.why: There is no such limit.

choices.text: It needs a graphics card
choices.why: It runs on a processor.

choices.text: A category has no point halfway between two values
